newsitem.title: JAPAN: TENNIS-SELES BEATS SANCHEZ VICARIO TO WIN NICHIREI TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SELES BEATS SANCHEZ VICARIO TO WIN NICHIREI TOURNAMENT.

text.p: Top seeded American Monica Seles won the Nichirei international tournament here on Sunday when she beat Arantxa Sanchez Vicario of Spain 6-1 6-4 in the rain-delayed final.
Seles who won the event in 1991 and 1992, pocketed $79,000 with her fifth victory of the year.
Seles said she was impressed by thousands of fans braving heavy rain and gusts caused by typhoon Violet and told them: "I love this tournament."
Both Seles and Sanchez Vicario seemed to have trouble concentrating as the final was delayed by 70 minutes due to rain leaking through the closed retractable roof at the Ariake Colosseum.
Second seed Sanchez, who has won only one of her 13 career matches against Seles, took the lead in the second set 4-3, but Seles took the next three games to end the match.
Although Sanchez hit more winners than Seles, she produced almost twice as many unforced errors.
